lines.text: I wanna be a grown-up, just like Ludmilla.
If you need anything from Snowfield, just let me know.
I'm not so sure what you mean by "Merry Christmas".

Hehe, this is the first time I've worn something this pretty.
I really love it!

Since I have you and Belorta,
I'm sure this is gonna be a wonderful Christmas.

I'd love to take a walk with you at Snowfield...
Gah! Erm... pretend you didn't hear that.
Sorry, but I've got a lot of things to take care of at Snowfield. Could I be excused?
I'll wait here for you until you get here, so take your time.
Be sure to come and visit Snowfield whenever you've got a chance!
Oh no... I was running an errand and I got lost!

Old-Timer,
have you seen Belorta or Ludmilla?

Even with snow all around you, this is a place where you can cozy up and get warm. Welcome to Snowfield Hot Spring.
Does that sound okay...?
With this much strength, I feel like I can protect everyone!
I'll do my best, Old-Timer!
Thank you for helping me!

Oh my goodness, thank you!
I'll treasure this forever.
Wow... Is this a Christmas gift?
Oooh, I'll put this on display at Snowfield!
Is this how it feels to like someone?
I always feel so at ease when I'm with you.

Belorta is the best... but I also like you, Old-Timer... and Ludmilla is great too...
Ohh, I can't choose!
Oh... can I really do this?
Did you call?
Am I going the right way?
Ah! Encounter!
Let's finish this fast so we can have a party!
I'll protect you, Old-Timer!
Uhh... There are too many of them!
Wait!
C'mon, faster...
Reloading!
Let's get started, shall we?

Leave Snowfield Hot Spring to me!
... Squeaky clean now!
Everyone can have a blast at Snowfield Hot Spring.
I did it!
Did you see that, Old-Timer?
Whoa!
Ah!
That hurt...
Argh!
I think I'm gonna go take a rest.
Old-Timer! Let's hurry back to Snowfield! Hehe.
